name: Pointed gourd
description: Small striped gourd, light enough to be fed to the recovering.

tcm.note: Outside the Chinese record; grouped with the cooling gourds.

ayurveda.note: Patola is classically shita, laghu (light) and deepana — named in texts as suitable during fever.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
